sections.title: Vieta's Formulas (Cubic and Biquadratic Equations)
sections.content: The sum and product of roots of cubic and biquadratic equations can be directly obtained from the coefficients. Example: For x³ + px² + qx + r = 0, α+β+γ = -p, αβ+βγ+γα = q, αβγ = -r

sections.title: Modulus Inequalities and Equations
sections.content: To solve equations like |x-a| + |x-b| = c, split x into intervals and solve linear equations in each interval. Example: |x-2| + |x-5| = 6 → solve for x ∈ [2,5]

sections.title: Remainder of Large Powers
sections.content: To find the remainder of x^n divided by x²-1, observe patterns. Example: x^99 ÷ (x²-1), since x² ≡ 1, x^99 ≡ x mod (x²-1)

sections.title: AM-GM Inequality Applications
sections.content: For n non-negative numbers: (a1+a2+...+an)/n ≥ (a1*a2*...*an)^(1/n). Example: For 4 and 9, AM = 6.5, GM = 6

sections.title: Symmetric Expressions and Homogeneous Equations
sections.content: Use expressions like S1 = α+β+γ and S2 = α²+β²+γ². Homogeneous equations have terms of the same degree.

sections.title: Roots under Special Conditions
sections.content: If roots are in AP, GP, or HP, express them using relations. Example: Roots in AP: α-d, α, α+d → α+β+γ = 3α

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
1) Forgetting signs in Vieta's formulas
2) Ignoring intervals in modulus equations
3) Missing patterns in large powers
4) Using negative numbers in AM-GM

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Level 2 Algebra focuses on formulas and patterns. Vieta, modulus, large powers, AM-GM, and roots in AP/GP/HP are key. Stepwise approach is important.

tricks.title: Vieta Shortcuts
tricks.explanation: Use the coefficients directly to find the sum and product of roots.

tricks.title: Modulus Equation Solving
tricks.explanation: Split into intervals and solve linear equations for each interval.

tricks.title: Large Power Remainder
tricks.explanation: Use patterns like x² ≡ 1 mod (x²-1) → x^n ≡ x or 1

tricks.title: AM-GM Quick Check
tricks.explanation: For two numbers a and b, √(ab) ≤ (a+b)/2

tricks.title: Roots in AP/GP/HP
tricks.explanation: Express middle root and relate others with difference or ratio.
tricks.example: Roots in AP: α-d, α, α+d → sum = 3α

tricks.title: Symmetric Expression Trick
tricks.example: If α+β+γ=6, αβ+βγ+γα=11, αβγ=6, then α²+β²+γ² = (α+β+γ)² - 2(αβ+βγ+γα)=14

tricks.title: Homogeneous Equation Simplification
tricks.explanation: Divide all terms by the highest degree variable to reduce order.
tricks.example: x²y + xy² → factor xy to simplify
